list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Fed from kube-state-metrics, never from process_start_time_seconds: oracle is minReplicaCount 0, so a process-lifecycle metric leaves this variable — and every panel, including the backlog and KEDA rows that survive the sleeping pod — empty in the connector's normal state.

list.name: pod
list.label: Pod
list.description: allValue is .+ and not .*: every series is scraped twice in dev (PodMonitor plus the kubernetes-services catch-all) and only the PodMonitor copy carries a pod label. In PromQL .* also matches the absent label, which doubles every additive aggregation while leaving percentiles and _sum/_count ratios correct.

list.name: query_type
list.label: Query type
list.description: allValue .* on purpose: query_type is a business label, not the duplicate-scrape discriminator.

options.content:
**This is the drill-down.** The Overview says *what happened*; this board says *how much it cost* and *how it was distributed*. Nothing here is repeated from the Overview.

**Totals add up every scan in the time range** — narrow the range to one scan to describe one database.

**Heatmaps show one cell per owner or per query**, so a single slow one stands out instead of disappearing into an average.

Hover the ⓘ on any panel for what it counts, what is normal, and where to look next.

panels.title: Time per Object
panels.description:
**Average time to scan one table or view**, in milliseconds, end to end inside its owner: listing, reading its columns, sending its documents, plus its share of the owner's fixed cost.

**Normal:** a few hundred ms. Multiply by the number of tables to estimate a bigger database. It is the same total time as 'Time per Column' beside it, divided by tables instead of columns — so Time per Object ≈ Time per Column × Columns per Object.

**Next:** 'Time per Column' beside it.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

panels.title: Time per Column
panels.description:
**The same total time divided by columns instead of tables**, in milliseconds. It is not how long one column takes to read — columns are read together, one query per table.

**Normal:** tens of ms. If it stays flat while Time per Object moves, the tables got wider, not slower.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

panels.title: Objects per Owner
panels.description:
**Average tables and views per owner**, counting only owners that have some.

**Normal:** any number — but databases are rarely uniform. One big owner hides inside an average.

**Next:** the 'Owner Duration — distribution' heatmap below shows each owner as a cell.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) - ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Columns per Object
panels.description:
**Average width of a table**, in columns.

**Normal:** any number. A very wide table (hundreds of columns) moves this and the cost per table together.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

panels.title: Owner Duration — distribution
panels.description:
**How long each owner took, over time.** **How to read it:** time runs left to right, duration bottom to top. Each box is 'this many owners took this long, at this moment' — the colour says how many (brighter = more), and hovering a box shows the exact number as Value. Colours do not identify individual owners.

**Normal:** one tight band when owners are similar. Boxes far above the band are the slow owners — the board cannot name them.

**Next:** 'Owners by Duration' beside it gives the same counts for the whole range, easier to read for a single scan.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__interval:15s]))

panels.title: Owners by Duration (window)
panels.description:
**How many owners took how long**, for the whole range — the heatmap beside it collapsed into one bar per duration range. Only ranges with at least one owner are shown.

**Normal:** most owners in one or two neighbouring bars. A few owners several bars above the rest are the big ones. Note that every owner pays a fixed cost (listing its tables, extended metadata), so even an empty owner takes a while.

panels.title: Query Duration — distribution
panels.description:
**How long each SQL query took, over time**, filtered by the Query type selector at the top. **How to read it:** time runs left to right, duration bottom to top. Each box is 'this many queries took this long, at this moment' — the colour says how many (brighter = more), and hovering a box shows the exact number as Value. Colours do not identify individual queries.

**Normal:** most boxes low. Column queries run once per table, so they dominate the count.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[15s]) * 1)[$__interval:15s]))

panels.title: Query p95 by query_type
panels.description:
**How slow the slowest 5% of each kind of query was**, over time. list_tables runs once per owner, query_columns once per table, the rest once per owner for extended metadata.

**Normal:** only readable under sustained load. For a single scan use the mean beside it.

**Next:** the Overview's 'Query Time by Type' for where the time went in total.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, query_type) (rate(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[5m])))

panels.title: Query Mean by query_type (5m)
panels.description:
**Average time per query of each kind.** The average is the one that multiplies: average × number of calls = total time.

**Normal:** column queries well under a second.

targets.expr: sum by (query_type) (rate(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[5m])) / sum by (query_type) (rate(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[5m]))

panels.title: Query Count by Type (window)
panels.description:
**How many queries of each kind ran** — a count, not time. For where the time went, see 'Query Time by Type' on the Overview.

**Normal:** query_columns = tables scanned + tables failed; list_tables = owner attempts; the metadata kinds = owners with tables, when the scan has DBA access.

targets.expr: sum by (query_type) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", query_type=~"$query_type"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0

panels.title: Fetch Duration — p50 / p95 by outcome
panels.description:
**How long samples took, split into successes and failures**, so fast failures do not make successes look quicker than they are.

**Normal:** only readable under sustained load.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(oracle_content_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(oracle_content_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: Stream Duration — p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description:
**Only the part spent reading rows from Oracle and uploading them.** The whole fetch minus this is setup: credentials, connection, looking up the column type.

**Normal:** most of the fetch time on big tables; little on small ones.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(oracle_content_stream_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(oracle_content_stream_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(oracle_content_stream_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: Stream Throughput
panels.description:
**Speed while streaming, adjusted for size.**

**Normal:** steady. If fetches get slower and this holds, the samples just got bigger; if this drops, something really got slower.

targets.expr: sum(rate(oracle_content_stream_bytes_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(oracle_content_stream_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])), 1e-9)
sum(rate(oracle_content_stream_rows_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(oracle_content_stream_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Stream Bytes — distribution
panels.description:
**Size of each successful sample, over time.** **How to read it:** each box is 'this many samples were this big, at this moment'; brighter = more, hover for the exact count.

**Normal:** values are cut at 4000 characters, so a text/CLOB sample tops out around rows × 4000 bytes.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_stream_bytes_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_stream_bytes_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_stream_bytes_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__interval:15s]))

panels.title: Stream Rows — distribution
panels.description:
**Rows in each successful sample, over time.** **How to read it:** each box is 'this many samples were this big, at this moment'; brighter = more, hover for the exact count.

**Normal:** between 100 and 1000 (ORACLE_CONTENT_SAMPLE_MIN_ROWS / MAX_ROWS). Below 100 means small tables, not a broken sampler.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_stream_rows_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_stream_rows_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_stream_rows_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__interval:15s]))

panels.title: Sample Attempts (window)
panels.description:
**How many tries each successful sample needed.** A retry happens when a random sample returns too few rows or none; 4 means the last try read the whole column.

**Normal:** almost all in '1 attempt'. Many in 2–4 means the sample percentage is too low for this data.

**Next:** 'Empty Samples by kind' on the Overview.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"1(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"1(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"1(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))

sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"2(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"2(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"2(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) - sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"1(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"1(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"1(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))

sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"3(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"3(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"3(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) - sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"2(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"2(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"2(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))

sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"4(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"4(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"4(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) - sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"3(\\.0)?"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"3(\\.0)?"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", le=~"3(\\.0)?"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))

panels.title: Empty Samples by kind (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When samples came back empty**, same colours as on the Overview.

**Normal:** rare bumps; the counts are on the Overview.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Truncation & Size Limit (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When long values were cut** (only the first 4000 characters were sampled) **and when whole samples stopped at the 100 MB limit.**

**Normal:** flat unless there are long text or CLOB columns.

targets.expr: sum(rate(oracle_content_values_truncated_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))
sum(rate(oracle_content_sample_budget_stopped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))
